# Tcl runtime notice

`Tcl-8.6.15-license.terms` is the unmodified Tcl 8.6.15 notice retrieved on 2026-10-22 from:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tcltk/tcl/core-8-6-15/license.terms

SHA-256: `c0a69a2bfd757361ec7e6143973b103c90409316b49e9c88db26ad6388e79f16`

It is used only when bundling the verified Tcl 8.6.15 runtime and the local Python installation omits a separate Tcl notice. Other runtime versions require their own matching notice. The Tk notice is copied from the installed Tk runtime. No Tcl/Tk source implementation is copied into the project.
## Additional runtime notices for 0.3.0

The CTranslate2 4.8.3 and tokenizers 0.23.3 wheels did not contain license files; their license texts were retrieved from the corresponding official Git tags. The flatbuffers 25.12.19 wheel omitted its notice; the official upstream Apache-2.0 license text is retained here. FFmpeg's LGPLv3 and GPLv3 texts accompany the shared libraries included by the PyAV wheel. Retrieval URLs and file hashes are in `additional-license-sources.json`. These are license notices, not complete source archives or a claim that a particular upstream source tag exists.
